items.title: Trey McBride: Another productive performance
items.description:
McBride hauled in seven of eight targets for 72 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 33-30 overtime victory at Dallas.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Huntley: May have turf-toe injury
items.description:
Huntley sustained what could be a turf-toe injury during Sunday's 36-10 loss at Buffalo, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chase Brown: Solid all-around day in OT win
items.description:
Brown rushed 12 times for 55 yards and brought in eight of nine targets for 46 yards in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylen Warren: Ties career high in rushing yards
items.description:
Warren rushed 17 times for 143 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for no gain in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
